title: A Task as States, Actions and Rewards: A Grid with a Pit, Moves That Slip, and the Value of Following a Policy

artifact.note: a task for learning by trial, written as a Markov decision process: a grid of cells with walls, a goal and a pit, four moves that go where they are meant to most of the time and slip sideways otherwise, a reward for every step and for arriving; the outcomes of a move with their chances; a policy as a move for every cell; its value (the expected discounted sum of rewards from each cell) found by sweeping the Bellman equation until it settles; and the same value estimated by running the policy many times, to show what the number means
